title: Approximate tangent space of a compact C¹ image at an interior regular point
statement: Let k, P ∈ ℕ, V ⊆ ℝ^k open, χ : ℝ^k → ℝ^P of class C¹ on V (ContDiffOn ℝ 1 χ V), C ⊆ V compact with χ injective on C, and y ∈ int C with Dχ(y) = fderiv ℝ χ y injective. Then χ(C) has approximate tangent space Q := Dχ(y)(ℝ^k) (= LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ χ y)) at χ(y) in the sense of Simon Ch. 3, Definition 1.4 (HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt k (χ '' C) (χ y) Q): dim Q = k and, for every continuous compactly supported f : ℝ^P → ℝ, ∫_{η_{χ(y),r}(χ(C))} f dH^k → ∫_Q f dH^k as r ↓ 0, where η_{x,r}(z) = r⁻¹(z − x) and H^k = μHE[k].
lean_statement: ∀ (k P : ℕ) (V C : Set (Euclid k)) (χ : Euclid k → Euclid P) (y : Euclid k), IsOpen V → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 χ V → IsCompact C → C ⊆ V → InjOn χ C → y ∈ interior C → Injective (fderiv ℝ χ y) → HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt k (χ '' C) (χ y) (LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ χ y : Euclid k →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P))
